Sheet.name: Name
Sheet.interestHint: The thing that gets you into trouble

Roll.empty: A pool needs at least one die.
Roll.summaryOne: One die. Read it as it falls.

pool.scholar: It falls within my occupation or scholarly interest
pool.noticeHint: The Notice die. If it is highest, a Notice roll follows.
pool.meddleHint: The Meddle die. If it is highest, or ties, Notice rises.

line.meddleRemarked: The Meddle die is highest. The meddling was remarked: Notice rises to {notice}.
line.meddleRemarkedMax: The Meddle die is highest. The meddling was remarked, though Notice can rise no further.
line.meddleUnremarked: Another die beats the Meddle die. The meddling went unremarked.
line.noticeDie: The Notice die is highest. A Notice roll follows.
line.meddleTie: The Meddle and Notice dice tie for highest. A Notice roll follows.
line.glimpse: A glimpse of what is really happening. A Notice roll follows.
line.gmMayCall: Something is wrong. The GM may call for a Notice roll.

investigate.low: The bare minimum you need to go on.
investigate.four: What a competent scholar would find.
investigate.five: More: a parallel case, a remembered footnote, a local story.
investigate.six: A glimpse of what is really happening.

other.low: Fail, or succeed at a cost the GM names.

1.label: Unremarked
1.text: Nothing has turned to look at you.

2.label: Glanced at
2.text: A sense, now and then, of not being quite alone.

3.label: Regarded
3.text: Something has begun to take an interest.

5.label: Followed
5.text: It is seldom far behind you now.

6.label: Found
6.text: It knows you. The next time you are alone, it will come.

NoticeRoll.title: {name}: a Notice roll

reason.called: The GM calls for a Notice roll
reason.glimpse: A glimpse of what is really happening
reason.meddleTie: Meddle and Notice tied for highest

NoticeRoll.rises: It beats your Notice of {before}. Notice rises to {after}.
NoticeRoll.holds: It does not beat your Notice of {before}. Unremarked, this time.
NoticeRoll.max: Notice is already 6. It can know you no better.

Meddle.heading: Meddlings
Meddle.placeholder: Blowing the whistle; prising up the lid…

Banner.marked: It knows you. The next time you are alone, it comes for you.
Banner.visited: You have suffered the Visit. Whatever your Notice, your epilogue is the worst of them.

Marked.text: It knows you now. The next time you are alone, it will come for you. Stay in company.

Visit.title: The Visit: it comes for {name}
Visit.text: The table plays the scene out. You cannot win it.
Visit.choices: You may run, hide or endure.

Failure.beats: It beats your {highest}. You fail as described.
Failure.holds: It does not beat your {highest}. Your result stands.

Leave.title: Leave the story
Leave.confirm: {name} flees the district, burns the papers, swears never to speak of it. They will be out of the story for good. Leave?
Leave.falls: Lower than your Notice of {before}. Notice falls to {after}.
Leave.holds: Not lower than your Notice of {before}. You carry it away with you.

Epilogue.heading: Epilogue, were the story to end now

untouched.label: Untouched
untouched.text: Perhaps a little quieter at dinner.

unwell.label: Never quite well again
unwell.text: Will not discuss it; sleeps with a light on.

ruined.label: Ruined
ruined.text: Gone abroad, hair turned white, or found in the morning.

Curio.heading: Curios
Curio.originHint: The Templars' preceptory, under the altar stone

Haunting.maxim: Build the story around a transgression already made and a single entity tethered to an object or place.
Haunting.transgressionHint: Who took, opened or disturbed what, and when?
Haunting.thingHint: What it is. Never describe it whole.
Haunting.tetherHint: The object or place it is bound to.
Haunting.restitutionHint: Return the object, finish the interrupted rite, give back what was taken.
Haunting.frameHint: “My friend never spoke of what happened at Burnstow…”
Haunting.emptyEntry: There is nothing written there yet.

horror.label: Horror
horror.text: In the room. Once per story

Rest.hint: The only true victory is restitution.

Glimpse.heading: Glimpses
Glimpse.hint: Stay reticent. Never describe it whole.

Warning.heading: Warnings
Warning.hint: An inscription, a sexton's remark, a note in a margin, locals who won't come up the lane. Ignoring one is meddling.
Warning.placeholder: “I shouldn't go digging up there, sir, if I was you.”

Provenance.heading: Provenance
Provenance.hint: Letters, registers, engravings, a diary, the object itself. Every essential clue must be reachable without meddling; meddling gets there faster, or further.
Provenance.titlePlaceholder: A letter; the parish register; an engraving…

Company.hint: Company is safe, so splitting up is always a choice.
Company.none: No Investigators yet. Create one from the Actors sidebar.
Company.noticeHint: Call for a Notice roll: they have seen something wrong.
Company.newStoryConfirm: Return every Investigator to Notice 1, with a clean conscience? Their meddlings, Visits and departures are forgotten.

slow.label: Escalate slowly.
slow.text: Unease, dread, terror, horror: the last only once.

reticent.label: Stay reticent.
reticent.text: A hand, damp linen, hair, the wrong number of limbs felt in the dark.

comfort.label: Bracket the horror with comfort.
comfort.text: Sherry, fussy antiquarian dispute, dry humour.

bargain.label: Offer a bargain
bargain.text: when the table is cautious and the story slows.

clues.label: Keep it legible.
clues.text: Players may know the cost when their characters don't.

noticeTies.name: The Notice die wins ties with Light dice
noticeTies.hint: By default the Notice die calls for a Notice roll only when it is highest outright, or when it ties the Meddle die for highest. Switch on to have it count whenever it ties for highest.

playersSetNotice.name: Players may set Notice by hand
playersSetNotice.hint: Let players click the candles on their own sheet. By default only the GM may; the dice do the rest.

atmosphere.name: Atmosphere
atmosphere.hint: The dark draws in around the screen as your Investigator's Notice rises.

sounds.name: Sounds
sounds.hint: A latch, somewhere, when your Notice rises.
